tool_return.title: Better Than Me (Terry Dexter song)
tool_return.text: "Better Than Me" is a song co-written and performed by Terry Dexter. The song appears as the opening track on her eponymous debut album and was issued as the album's second single. It is Dexter's only song to date to chart on the "Billboard" Hot 100, peaking at #99 in 1999.
